actions.deactivateVoucher: A 'voucher' is a claim code used to register agents; deactivating it blocks any further registrations with it.

vouchers.continuous: A voucher that can be reused to register multiple agents, as opposed to single-use.
vouchers.available: Voucher status: not yet used by any agent to register.
vouchers.claimed: Voucher status: already used by an agent to register.
vouchers.systemLabel: Marks a voucher/agent as system-wide, serving all teams rather than belonging to one.

install.mode: Choice between the auto-updating launcher and the standalone (manually updated) agent binary.
install.modeStandalone: Installs the agent as a plain binary that must be manually re-downloaded to upgrade.

diagReasons.blocklisted: This agent's hashcat benchmark marked it incompatible/blocklisted for this job, so it isn't being given work on it.
diagReasons.rejectionCooldown: The agent recently rejected a task assignment and is temporarily not being offered new work.
diagReasons.atCapacity: Every job this agent is compatible with already has as many agents assigned as it's allowed.

activity.lastCheckpoint: The last saved hashcat progress position the task can resume from after an interruption.

hardware.runtime: The GPU compute backend/driver interface (e.g. CUDA, OpenCL, HIP) used by this device, not elapsed time.
hardware.deviceId: Hardware identifier (e.g. PCI bus ID) used to track this GPU's identity across reboots.

debug.buffer: Size of the in-memory debug-log buffer kept by the agent before it's flushed or discarded.

scheduling.active: Whether the agent's schedule is enabled for this specific day — not whether the agent itself is currently online.
